correctness.rationale: Root split K is uniform in {0,...,n-1}, L_n=1+L_K for n>=1 and Z_n=Z_K+Z_(n-1-K) for n>=2, with exceptional b_0=0 and b_1=1. The four boundary corrections to b_k=(k+1)/3 produce conditional covariance (n-2)/(3n(n-1)); total-covariance recursion gives v_3=1/18 and v_n-v_(n-1)=1/[3n(n-1)(n-2)] for n>=4, yielding the stated rational formula and limits. Independent exact enumeration of all n! priority permutations for 2<=n<=7 reproduced all covariances, including base n=2 and n=3. Variance normalization uses record-count variance H_n-H_n^(2) and fringe leaf variance 2(n+1)/45 for n>=4. A finite check is not the all-n proof.

final_claim: For a uniform insertion-order n-node binary search tree, the number of nodes on the leftmost root-to-minimum path and the number of ordinary childless nodes have covariance (n-2)(n+1)/(12n(n-1)) for all n>=3 (zero at n=2); it strictly increases to 1/12 with increments 1/[3n(n-1)(n-2)].
limitations: Uniform random insertion BST, not uniform Catalan tree or rebalanced BST; leaf is nonempty childless vertex.
